title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Who We Are?

Softensity is a US-based IT outsourcing company with global software teams. We are headquartered in Atlanta, GA, USA with development teams in LATAM, Eastern Europe and Türkiye. When you have better teams, you build better software. Let’s do this together!


We are currently seeking a dynamic and inquisitive Senior Software Engineer with strong technical skills and the ability to navigate organizational dynamics, with of adaptability and foundational knowledge in security applications


The Project:

Our client’s platform runs on the Microsoft Azure cloud and follows a microservices architecture. They run a mix of open source, vendor-licensed, and internally developed tools to perform functions such as provisioning, software deployment, logging, and monitoring.

You'll learn these tools and have opportunities to improve them. The team is collaborative; they work closely with the development teams and support to deliver the best results for the organization. The goal is to balance the best solution with the need to get things done for each engineering challenge we face.


Technical Skills:

Must have

  • Proficiency in .NET Core
  • Proficiency in Cloud (ideally Azure , but AWS or GCP are acceptable)
  • Strong background in Microservices architecture
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Bicep , ARM templates , Terraform , or Pulumi
  • Experience with Event Hubs , Service Bus , or similar
  • Knowledge of Container Apps , Function Apps , App Services
  • Experience with Storage Accounts , CDN , Subscriptions , Resource Groups
  • Understanding of App Insights , Log Analytics
  • Experience managing RBAC , Managed Identities , SPNs , App Registrations
  • Hands-on experience with Docker
  • Database skills with Azure SQL, MongoDB, SQL, and Cosmos DB

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with GitHub Actions or similar CI/CD tools
  • Familiarity with cloud automation , especially infrastructure automation
  • Comfortable exploring Infrastructure as Code (IaC) , Developer Experience (DX) , UI , and architecture as necessary
  • Familiarity with widely used Azure resources , including ASB/Event Hub , AKS/ACA , Storage Account


Why Join Us?

We are passionate about top quality talent and giving our team members the tools they need for them to keep on growing and learning. The sky is truly the limit and we want you to feel challenged and motivated in every single project that you're a part of all while working with cutting edge technologies and amazing clients.


What to expect?

  • Coursera credentials
  • Remote work
  • Learning opportunities


Softensity is an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants are considered without regard to gender, identity, or personal background.

title: Gerente de projetos de TI
description:
Quem somos:

A Studio Rx é uma empresa de produção global digital, criada para as necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como Hub de produção da IPG Health, o Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo, tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência.


O que buscamos:

Como Gerente de Projetos, você trabalhará em colaboração com a equipe do Studio Rx e os times de Projetos e Client Services nos EUA. Diariamente, você deverá monitorar as atividades dos projetos em andamento, identificando e mitigando riscos, além de manter uma comunicação fluída entre todas as equipes envolvidas.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolvimento do plano do projeto: desde o entendimento e definição do escopo/briefing, passando pela estimativa de esforço e elaboração de cronogramas;
  • Alocação de equipe de acordo com habilidades necessárias, experiência e disponibilidade em parceria com o líder técnico da área de execução do projeto;
  • Gerenciamento e monitoramento das atividades diárias do projeto, garantindo o recebimento de todas as informações e materiais para execução das atividades, seguindo os protocolos de trabalho do Studio no Brasil e EUA;
  • Identificação, avaliação e mitigação de riscos, consolidando as informações em relatórios para a liderança sênior do projeto;

description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições:​

Desenvolvimento de soluções robustas e escaláveis em ambientes bancários.

Manutenção e evolução de sistemas legados em Java, além de migração para arquiteturas modernas (microserviços).

Implementação de testes unitários e regressivos para garantir a qualidade do código.

Aplicação de práticas de observabilidade para monitoramento de sistemas.

Identificação e tratamento de vulnerabilidades de segurança.

Colaboração com equipes multidisciplinares para aprimorar continuamente os processos e produtos.

Experiência sólida em Java (versões 8, 17, 21).

Ter noções de DevOps.

Foco em qualidade: testes unitários, testes regressivos, Sonar e tratamento de vulnerabilidades de segurança.

Conhecimento em observabilidade.

Experiência com DDD (Domain-Driven Design).

Conhecimento em Spring.

Capacidade crítica para identificar e implementar melhorias.

Familiaridade com JSP e monolitos em Java.

Experiência com microserviços, BFF (Backend for Frontend), Lambda, SQS e Kafka.


Diferenciais:​

Experiência prévia em projetos no setor bancário.

Capacidade de trabalho em ambientes remotos.

Valorizamos a diversidade em nossa equipe.

title: Consultor(a) SAP ABAP
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


As pessoas são e continuarão sendo uma parte importante dessa missão. Em tudo o que fazemos, nossos funcionários desempenham um papel decisivo para nossos clientes e uns para os outros. É por isso que estamos sempre em busca de profissionais experientes e em início de carreira para se juntarem à nossa equipe.


Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.


Estamos em busca de um Consultor Desenvolvedor ABAP com experiência em Desenvolvimento e Depuração para integrar nossa equipe de AMS.


Responsabilidade:


O profissional será responsável por fazer análise dos processos desenvolvidos, encontrando falhas e propondo ajustes, desenvolver e manter soluções SAP avançadas, técnicas e garantindo a entrega de alta qualidade atendo diversos clientes de diversos setores.


Formato de Trabalho: Remoto

Contratação: CLT



Requisitos :

  • Conhecimento avançado em Depuração objetos Standards e Desenvolvidos
  • Desenvolver e manter programas complexos em ABAP para atender às necessidades dos clientes.
  • Realizar análise de requisitos e documentação técnica detalhada.
  • Colaborar com equipes funcionais e outros desenvolvedores para transformar requisitos de negócios em soluções técnicas.
  • Garantir a conformidade com as melhores práticas de desenvolvimento SAP e padrões de qualidade.
  • Fornecer suporte técnico avançado e resolução de problemas relacionados às soluções desenvolvidas.
  • Atuar como mentor e líder técnico para desenvolvedores de nível júnior e pleno.
  • Participar ativamente em projetos de implementação e atualização de sistemas SAP.



Formação e experiência desejada:

  • Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento ABAP.
  • Conhecimento em formulários (AdobeForm, Smarforms e SapScript )
  • Conhecimento e experiência em SAP Fiori, incluindo SAPUI5 e OData.
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento e manutenção de workflows SAP.
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de relatórios, interfaces, conversões, melhoramentos e formulários
  • Capacidade de entender e traduzir especificações funcionais complexas em soluções técnicas eficazes.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente e liderar equipes técnicas.



Diferenciais:

  • Certificações SAP relevantes.
  • Experiência em projetos de implementação SAP S/4HANA.
  • Conhecimentos em outras tecnologias SAP como SAP Gateway, AMDPs, BTP, Webdympro.
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Participação em projetos internacionais ou ambientes multiculturais.

title: Analista Junior de Qualidade - BPO / Bilíngue (POR-ENG)
description:
The Quality Analyst provides support to internal and external sales teams, relieving them of administrative or related tasks. Uses intermediate to advanced knowledge of the products and services offered to support customers and sales teams.


Job objective:

To increase the effectiveness of the sales process, ensuring that the highest sales quality standards are consistently met across all our operations in Brazil. This involves monitoring, evaluation, and training to optimize sales performance and customer satisfaction.


Your responsibilities:

  • Audit and evaluate sales calls and communications to ensure compliance with company standards and regulatory requirements.
  • Develop quality improvement strategies based on audit findings, with a focus on improving the customer experience.
  • Provide constructive feedback and customized training sessions to the sales team based on identified gaps.
  • Work closely with sales managers to refine sales processes and implement best practice guidelines.
  • Compile detailed reports on quality assurance metrics for review by senior management.


Requirements:

  • More than 2 years of experience in a quality assurance role in a sales-oriented environment.
  • Strong analytical skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese and English (minimum level B2 - fluent).
  • Advanced skills in CRM software such as Salesforce and HubSpot.
  • Ability to work independently with a proactive approach to problem solving and process improvement.
  • Live in São Paulo - SP and have easy access to the Concentrix EZ Tower unit.


Benefits:


  • Assistência médica
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Auxílio-creche
  • Convênios e descontos comerciais
  • Seguro de vida
  • Vale-alimentação
  • Vale-refeição
  • Vale-transporte

title: Sales Manager -  Nutraceutical Ingredients ( LATAM)
description:
Sales Manager - Nutraceutical Ingredients ( LATAM)


Location: Brazil (Remote)


Territory: Latin America


About the Role


We’re seeking a Sales Manager to drive growth across LATAM. You will sell nutraceutical ingredients to the dietary supplement and functional food & beverage industries, building a high-quality pipeline and long-term customer relationships.


Responsibilities

• Manage and grow key accounts across LATAM, fostering senior-level relationships with brand owners, CDMOs/contract manufacturers, and distributors.

• Develop and execute country- and segment-level territory plans to capture new business.

• Present nutraceutical ingredients to customers, clearly articulating benefits, applications, and go-to-market plans.

• Collaborate with technical, regulatory, and marketing teams to deliver tailored solutions and product launches.

• Monitor market trends and competitor activity to identify white space and protect share.

• Meet and exceed quarterly/annual sales targets with accurate forecasting and disciplined CRM hygiene.

• Represent the company at regional trade shows, conferences, and industry events.

• Provide technical/product support to customers in coordination with internal teams.

• Maintain up-to-date knowledge of regional regulations and standards (e.g., ANVISA, COFEPRIS, INVIMA).


Requirements

• 5+ years of B2B sales experience in nutraceutical ingredients within LATAM.

• Strong understanding of nutraceutical ingredients and their applications in dietary supplements and functional F&B.

• Proven ability to prospect, build pipelines, negotiate, and close across multiple countries.

• Language: Fluent Portuguese and strong Spanish; English is a plus.

• Self-starter comfortable working remotely; excellent territory/time management.

• Based in Brazil with willingness to travel across LATAM as required.

• Proficiency with MS Office and CRM (ZOHO preferred).

title: Java Software Engineer
description:
ENGLISH RESUMES ONLY


Join NFQ!

We are a global consultancy specialized in business, technology, and operations. We offer an integrated vision that covers the entire value chain of organizations. Our team includes over 2,000 professionals across national and international offices.

At NFQ, we offer a different consulting model: Flexible | Scalable | Specialized | Close to clients .


We are looking for a Java Software Engineer with strong technical expertise, deep understanding of backend architecture, and experience in the financial sector to join a dynamic, fast-paced environment. The ideal candidate is hands-on, collaborative, and capable of leading complex solution design while bridging the gap between technology and business goals.


What will you do?

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend solutions using Java and Spring Boot.
  • Ensure adherence to architectural frameworks, coding standards, and best practices in highly regulated financial environments.
  • Build and integrate microservices in a cloud or hybrid environment.
  • Contribute to the design of backend systems supporting banking processes such as trade settlement, reconciliations, FX, and cash management.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality technical solutions.
  • Implement robust strategies for monitoring, alerts, metrics, and testing (e.g., TDD, BDD).
  • Participate actively in Agile delivery processes and ensure technology solutions align with business outcomes.


What are we looking for?

Must Have:

title: Data Warehouse Architect
description:
Databricks Data Warehouse ArchitectAbout the role:

One of the largest companies in the world in the Gaming industry is seeking a hands-on Data Architect with DataWarehouse Engineer expertise in Databricks (DBX) and AWS-native data services to spearhead the design and implementation of a new data warehouse instance for a major product line. This role will involve building from the ground up—architecting scalable pipelines, optimizing lakehouse performance, and integrating seamlessly with diverse real-time and batch data sources across AWS.

The ideal candidate is passionate about data architecture , thrives in fast-moving environments, and has a proven track record of setting up high-performance lakehouse platforms on Databricks with a strong foundation in data warehousing principles .

Key Responsibilities:
  • Design and deploy a new Databricks Lakehouse instance tailored to the client’s product-level data needs.
  • Architect and implement robust data ingestion pipelines using Spark (PySpark/Scala) and Delta Lake.
  • Integrate AWS-native services (S3, Glue, Athena, Redshift, Lambda) with Databricks for optimized performance and scalability.
  • Define data models, optimize query performance, and establish warehouse governance best practices.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product teams, data scientists, and DevOps to streamline data workflows.
  • Maintain CI/CD, preferably DBX for data pipelines using GitOps and Infrastructure-as-Code.
  • Monitor data jobs and resolve performance bottlenecks or failures across environments.
Required Skills & Experience: Databricks / Lakehouse Architecture
  • End-to-end setup of Databricks workspaces and Unity Catalog
  • Expertise in Delta Lake internals , file compaction, and schema enforcement
  • Advanced PySpark/SQL skills for ETL and transformations
AWS Native Integration
  • Deep experience with AWS Glue , S3 , Redshift Spectrum , Lambda , and Athena
  • IAM and VPC configuration knowledge for secure cloud integrations
Data Warehousing & Modeling
  • Strong grasp of modern dimensional modeling (star/snowflake schemas)
  • Experience setting up lakehouse design patterns for mixed workloads
Automation & DevOps
  • Familiarity with CI/CD for data engineering using tools like DBX, Terraform, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps
  • Proficient in monitoring tools like CloudWatch, Datadog, or New Relic for data pipelines
Bonus/Nice to Have:
  • Experience supporting gaming or real-time analytics workloads
  • Familiarity with Airflow , Kafka , or EventBridge
  • Exposure to data privacy and compliance practices (GDPR, CCPA)
Other Details:
  • Location : Latin America (LATAM) region - Remote, USA - Remote
  • Length : 1+ Year

Client : Gaming giant

title: Executivo de Território
description:
Estamos em busca de um profissional dinâmico e motivado para integrar nossa equipe comercial. Se você é apaixonado por desafios, tem atitude de dono e busca uma carreira de sucesso, essa oportunidade é para você!


Responsabilidades:

  • Visitar entre 8 a 12 Farmácias de pequeno e médio porte da região;
  • Planejar e identificar as oportunidades de vendas, verificar, executar MPDV, dentro das rotinas do PEX (Programa de Excelência) na base de PDVs;
  • Atingir as metas de vendas estabelecidas;
  • Participar das reuniões diárias – matinal e fechamento de vendas on-line, de segunda à sexta.
  • Participar de treinamentos e eventos para atualização e desenvolvimento profissional;


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Excelente comunicação e capacidade de negociação;
  • Capacidade analítica verificar e atuar nas oportunidades;
  • Disciplina para cumprimento de rotina;
  • Disposição para trabalhos externos e viagens estaduais;
  • Carteira de motorista B;
  • Experiência Comercial Bens de consumo, Bebidas, Sorvete, Canal conveniência, setor de Adquirência (desejável);
  • Proatividade, atitude de dono e foco em resultados;
  • Desejável: Cursando Ensino Superior (Cursos prioritários: Engenharias, Economia, Física, Estatísticas, Matemática, Adm,);
  • Residir na região de Fortaleza - CE (obrigatório)


Motivos para trabalhar na Legrand:

  • A Legrand oferece uma carreira acelerada com oportunidades de aprendizado e desenvolvimento real, em uma cultura de crescimento e meritocracia;

A Legrand hoje:

  • Empresa com mais de 100 SKUs, sendo 25 produtos líderes ou vice-líderes de mercado;
  • Faturamento anual superior a R$1 bilhão, com destaque para o produto Expec, que gera R$300 milhões por ano;

História recente:

  • Nos últimos três anos e meio, a Legrand dobrou de tamanho, aumentou seu market share e subiu duas posições no ranking, agora sendo a terceira maior;
  • Quintuplicou o número de colaboradores e foi certificada no ranking GTPW de melhores empresas para trabalhar nos últimos dois anos;
  • Novo lema “Viva a Vida”, focado em criar marcas amadas pelos consumidores.

One of the largest companies in the world in the Gaming industry is seeking a hands-on Data Architect with DataWarehouse Engineer expertise in Databricks (DBX) and AWS-native data services to spearhead the design and implementation of a new data warehouse instance for a major product line. This role will involve building from the ground up—architecting scalable pipelines, optimizing lakehouse performance, and integrating seamlessly with diverse real-time and batch data sources across AWS.

The ideal candidate is passionate about data architecture , thrives in fast-moving environments, and has a proven track record of setting up high-performance lakehouse platforms on Databricks with a strong foundation in data warehousing principles .

Key Responsibilities:
  • Design and deploy a new Databricks Lakehouse instance tailored to the client’s product-level data needs.
  • Architect and implement robust data ingestion pipelines using Spark (PySpark/Scala) and Delta Lake.
  • Integrate AWS-native services (S3, Glue, Athena, Redshift, Lambda) with Databricks for optimized performance and scalability.
  • Define data models, optimize query performance, and establish warehouse governance best practices.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product teams, data scientists, and DevOps to streamline data workflows.
  • Maintain CI/CD, preferably DBX for data pipelines using GitOps and Infrastructure-as-Code.
  • Monitor data jobs and resolve performance bottlenecks or failures across environments.
Required Skills & Experience: Databricks / Lakehouse Architecture
  • End-to-end setup of Databricks workspaces and Unity Catalog
  • Expertise in Delta Lake internals , file compaction, and schema enforcement
  • Advanced PySpark/SQL skills for ETL and transformations
AWS Native Integration
  • Deep experience with AWS Glue , S3 , Redshift Spectrum , Lambda , and Athena
  • IAM and VPC configuration knowledge for secure cloud integrations
Data Warehousing & Modeling
  • Strong grasp of modern dimensional modeling (star/snowflake schemas)
  • Experience setting up lakehouse design patterns for mixed workloads
Automation & DevOps
  • Familiarity with CI/CD for data engineering using tools like DBX, Terraform, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps
  • Proficient in monitoring tools like CloudWatch, Datadog, or New Relic for data pipelines
Bonus/Nice to Have:
  • Experience supporting gaming or real-time analytics workloads
  • Familiarity with Airflow , Kafka , or EventBridge
  • Exposure to data privacy and compliance practices (GDPR, CCPA)
Other Details:
  • Location : Latin America (LATAM) region - Remote, USA - Remote
  • Length : 1+ Year

One of the largest companies in the world in the Gaming industry is seeking a hands-on Data Architect with DataWarehouse Engineer expertise in Databricks (DBX) and AWS-native data services to spearhead the design and implementation of a new data warehouse instance for a major product line. This role will involve building from the ground up—architecting scalable pipelines, optimizing lakehouse performance, and integrating seamlessly with diverse real-time and batch data sources across AWS.

The ideal candidate is passionate about data architecture , thrives in fast-moving environments, and has a proven track record of setting up high-performance lakehouse platforms on Databricks with a strong foundation in data warehousing principles .

Key Responsibilities:
  • Design and deploy a new Databricks Lakehouse instance tailored to the client’s product-level data needs.
  • Architect and implement robust data ingestion pipelines using Spark (PySpark/Scala) and Delta Lake.
  • Integrate AWS-native services (S3, Glue, Athena, Redshift, Lambda) with Databricks for optimized performance and scalability.
  • Define data models, optimize query performance, and establish warehouse governance best practices.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product teams, data scientists, and DevOps to streamline data workflows.
  • Maintain CI/CD, preferably DBX for data pipelines using GitOps and Infrastructure-as-Code.
  • Monitor data jobs and resolve performance bottlenecks or failures across environments.
Required Skills & Experience: Databricks / Lakehouse Architecture
  • End-to-end setup of Databricks workspaces and Unity Catalog
  • Expertise in Delta Lake internals , file compaction, and schema enforcement
  • Advanced PySpark/SQL skills for ETL and transformations
AWS Native Integration
  • Deep experience with AWS Glue , S3 , Redshift Spectrum , Lambda , and Athena
  • IAM and VPC configuration knowledge for secure cloud integrations
Data Warehousing & Modeling
  • Strong grasp of modern dimensional modeling (star/snowflake schemas)
  • Experience setting up lakehouse design patterns for mixed workloads
Automation & DevOps
  • Familiarity with CI/CD for data engineering using tools like DBX, Terraform, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps
  • Proficient in monitoring tools like CloudWatch, Datadog, or New Relic for data pipelines
Bonus/Nice to Have:
  • Experience supporting gaming or real-time analytics workloads
  • Familiarity with Airflow , Kafka , or EventBridge
  • Exposure to data privacy and compliance practices (GDPR, CCPA)
Other Details:
  • Location : Latin America (LATAM) region - Remote, USA - Remote
  • Length : 1+ Year

Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Sobre o Cargo: Especialista Salesforce


Responsabilidades:

Perfil de liderança

Desenvolver soluções customizadas na plataforma Salesforce utilizando Apex, LWC (Lightning Web Components), Visualforce e triggers.

Implementar integrações com sistemas externos via APIs REST/SOAP.

Criar automações avançadas, componentes reutilizáveis e testes unitários com alta cobertura.

Otimizar queries e gerenciar limites da plataforma (governor limits).

Colaborar com times funcionais e administradores para entrega de soluções técnicas aderentes aos requisitos de negócio.

Apoiar a gestão do ciclo de vida de desenvolvimento (DevOps), incluindo controle de versões e deploys com ferramentas como SFDX, Git e pipelines de CI/CD


Requisitos:

Domínio de todas as etapas do ciclo no Salesforce

Experiência prévia em projetos Salesforce (atuando como desenvolvedor).

Vivência em ambientes ágeis (Scrum/Kanban) e em squads multidisciplinares.

Experiência prática com integrações complexas e grandes volumes de dados.


Desejável experiência em projetos de implementação de soluções escaláveis em empresas de médio e grande porte.



Modelo de trabalho:

100% remoto

title: Blockchain Engineering Manager (Remote - LATAM)
description:
Blockchain Engineering Manager

Location: Americas, Remote


About Us

Pointsville is an end-to-end alternative asset factory, offering solutions that bridge the gap between emerging digital financial technologies and traditional asset classes. We specialize in Alternative Asset Digitalization and Loyalty Innovation, empowering organizations to unlock new value through tokenization, stablecoin infrastructure, and real-world asset integration.


Our globally distributed team of innovators, builders, and thinkers is passionate about the future of finance. Join Pointsville and be part of shaping the future of digital finance!


Overview

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Blockchain Engineering Manager to lead, mentor, and grow a distributed team of software engineers. This role is responsible for driving execution, ensuring technical excellence, and fostering a high-performance culture that delivers reliable, scalable, and high-quality products aligned with Pointsville’s strategic goals.


What You’ll Do

Product Strategy and Planning

  • Lead, coach, and mentor engineers across multiple technical domains.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement.
  • Support career growth, performance management, and professional development.
  • Participate in recruiting, onboarding, and building a diverse, high-performing team.


Execution and Delivery

  • Oversee the end-to-end software development lifecycle, from planning and design to deployment and maintenance.
  • Partner with the CTO and Product Manager to translate product roadmaps into engineering execution plans.
  • Manage delivery timelines, resources, and technical dependencies to ensure on-time releases.
  • Proactively identify and remove blockers, ensuring team productivity and alignment.


Performance and Improvement

  • Establish and enforce engineering best practices across code quality, smart contract security, and infrastructure reliability.
  • Ensure scalability, security, and performance in blockchain and microservice-based environments.
  • Drive the adoption of modern DevOps practices (IaC, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, automated testing).
  • Stay current with emerging blockchain technologies, protocols, and DeFi developments to guide innovation and continuous improvement.


Qualifications & Experience

title: Especialista Salesforce
description:
Sobre a Empresa


Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Sobre o Cargo: Especialista Salesforce


Responsabilidades:

Perfil de liderança

Desenvolver soluções customizadas na plataforma Salesforce utilizando Apex, LWC (Lightning Web Components), Visualforce e triggers.

Implementar integrações com sistemas externos via APIs REST/SOAP.

Criar automações avançadas, componentes reutilizáveis e testes unitários com alta cobertura.

Otimizar queries e gerenciar limites da plataforma (governor limits).

Colaborar com times funcionais e administradores para entrega de soluções técnicas aderentes aos requisitos de negócio.

Apoiar a gestão do ciclo de vida de desenvolvimento (DevOps), incluindo controle de versões e deploys com ferramentas como SFDX, Git e pipelines de CI/CD


Requisitos:

Domínio de todas as etapas do ciclo no Salesforce

Experiência prévia em projetos Salesforce (atuando como desenvolvedor).

Vivência em ambientes ágeis (Scrum/Kanban) e em squads multidisciplinares.

Experiência prática com integrações complexas e grandes volumes de dados.


Desejável experiência em projetos de implementação de soluções escaláveis em empresas de médio e grande porte.



Modelo de trabalho:

100% remoto

Benefícios:

Vale Refeição - Cartão flash

title: Sales Operations Specialist — Integration Solution Team
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to transform food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage.

In less than one year, Keeta became an industry leader in Hong Kong, China. Soon after, we expanded into Saudi Arabia and are now present in more than 20 cities. Following our recent successful launch in Qatar, Kuwait and the UAE, we're bringing that same speed and innovation to more of the Middle East, and to Brazil.


Job Responsibilities

  • Target Management and Performance Tracking: Assist the business leader in setting and breaking down team sales targets, establish mechanisms for goal tracking and analysis, monitor and report sales data and performance to ensure the achievement of team goals.
  • Training Support: Plan and organize various training sessions for the sales team according to business needs, including onboarding, product knowledge, and sales skills training—driving continuous improvement of team capabilities.

  • At least 2 years of experience in sales operations, training support, or team management; experience in B2B business, internet, or technical roles is preferred.
  • Background in data analysis or business analysis (BA experience preferred), able to use data insights to optimize business processes and support decision making.
  • Solid skills in target management and team service awareness, able to drive performance achievement and ongoing process optimization.
  • Excellent communication and coordination skills, efficiently organizing training and team culture activities to foster team growth.
  • Proficient in office software, able to independently complete data reports, training materials, and process documentation.
  • Proactive, highly responsible, with strong teamwork spirit and cross-departmental collaboration awareness.
  • Native-level Portuguese; good English communication skills, capable of supporting international team collaboration.


Job Highlights

  • Deep involvement in team management and business process optimization, contributing to core business goals.
  • Join an international team, collaborate with colleagues from 26 countries, and enhance global vision and cross-cultural abilities.
  • Be part of an early-stage business, face diverse challenges and growth opportunities, and quickly advance personal capabilities.

title: Blockchain Engineering Manager (Remote - LATAM)
description:
Blockchain Engineering Manager

Location: Americas, Remote


About Us

Pointsville is an end-to-end alternative asset factory, offering solutions that bridge the gap between emerging digital financial technologies and traditional asset classes. We specialize in Alternative Asset Digitalization and Loyalty Innovation, empowering organizations to unlock new value through tokenization, stablecoin infrastructure, and real-world asset integration.


Our globally distributed team of innovators, builders, and thinkers is passionate about the future of finance. Join Pointsville and be part of shaping the future of digital finance!


Overview

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Blockchain Engineering Manager to lead, mentor, and grow a distributed team of software engineers. This role is responsible for driving execution, ensuring technical excellence, and fostering a high-performance culture that delivers reliable, scalable, and high-quality products aligned with Pointsville’s strategic goals.


What You’ll Do

Product Strategy and Planning

  • Lead, coach, and mentor engineers across multiple technical domains.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement.
  • Support career growth, performance management, and professional development.
  • Participate in recruiting, onboarding, and building a diverse, high-performing team.


Execution and Delivery

  • Oversee the end-to-end software development lifecycle, from planning and design to deployment and maintenance.
  • Partner with the CTO and Product Manager to translate product roadmaps into engineering execution plans.
  • Manage delivery timelines, resources, and technical dependencies to ensure on-time releases.
  • Proactively identify and remove blockers, ensuring team productivity and alignment.


Performance and Improvement

  • Establish and enforce engineering best practices across code quality, smart contract security, and infrastructure reliability.
  • Ensure scalability, security, and performance in blockchain and microservice-based environments.
  • Drive the adoption of modern DevOps practices (IaC, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, automated testing).
  • Stay current with emerging blockchain technologies, protocols, and DeFi developments to guide innovation and continuous improvement.


Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of software development experience, including 6+ years in an engineering leadership or management role.
  • Familiarity with blockchains such as Ethereum and other blockchains preferred
  • Familiarity with DeFi trading a plus
  • Software engineering background in frontend and backend services development
  • An understanding of microservice architecture and cloud-based deployments
  • Experience in modern software development practices such as infrastructure as code, test automation, CI/CD and containerization
  • Proven success leading technical teams through the full product lifecycle in Agile or startup environments.
  • Experience with modern programming languages and frameworks (e.g., Java, Python, Node.js, Go, or C#).
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to balance technical depth with people management and cross-functional alignment.


We are committed to providing equal opportunity for qualified applicants to contract positions, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. This is a contract opportunity, not a direct employment role.

title: Blockchain Engineering Manager (Remote - LATAM)
description:
Blockchain Engineering Manager

Location: Americas, Remote


About Us

Pointsville is an end-to-end alternative asset factory, offering solutions that bridge the gap between emerging digital financial technologies and traditional asset classes. We specialize in Alternative Asset Digitalization and Loyalty Innovation, empowering organizations to unlock new value through tokenization, stablecoin infrastructure, and real-world asset integration.


Our globally distributed team of innovators, builders, and thinkers is passionate about the future of finance. Join Pointsville and be part of shaping the future of digital finance!


Overview

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Blockchain Engineering Manager to lead, mentor, and grow a distributed team of software engineers. This role is responsible for driving execution, ensuring technical excellence, and fostering a high-performance culture that delivers reliable, scalable, and high-quality products aligned with Pointsville’s strategic goals.


What You’ll Do

Product Strategy and Planning

  • Lead, coach, and mentor engineers across multiple technical domains.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement.
  • Support career growth, performance management, and professional development.
  • Participate in recruiting, onboarding, and building a diverse, high-performing team.


Execution and Delivery

  • Oversee the end-to-end software development lifecycle, from planning and design to deployment and maintenance.
  • Partner with the CTO and Product Manager to translate product roadmaps into engineering execution plans.
  • Manage delivery timelines, resources, and technical dependencies to ensure on-time releases.
  • Proactively identify and remove blockers, ensuring team productivity and alignment.


Performance and Improvement

  • Establish and enforce engineering best practices across code quality, smart contract security, and infrastructure reliability.
  • Ensure scalability, security, and performance in blockchain and microservice-based environments.
  • Drive the adoption of modern DevOps practices (IaC, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, automated testing).
  • Stay current with emerging blockchain technologies, protocols, and DeFi developments to guide innovation and continuous improvement.


Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of software development experience, including 6+ years in an engineering leadership or management role.
  • Familiarity with blockchains such as Ethereum and other blockchains preferred
  • Familiarity with DeFi trading a plus
  • Software engineering background in frontend and backend services development
  • An understanding of microservice architecture and cloud-based deployments
  • Experience in modern software development practices such as infrastructure as code, test automation, CI/CD and containerization
  • Proven success leading technical teams through the full product lifecycle in Agile or startup environments.
  • Experience with modern programming languages and frameworks (e.g., Java, Python, Node.js, Go, or C#).
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to balance technical depth with people management and cross-functional alignment.


We are committed to providing equal opportunity for qualified applicants to contract positions, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. This is a contract opportunity, not a direct employment role.

title: Blockchain Engineering Manager (Remote - LATAM)
description:
Blockchain Engineering Manager

Location: Americas, Remote


About Us

Pointsville is an end-to-end alternative asset factory, offering solutions that bridge the gap between emerging digital financial technologies and traditional asset classes. We specialize in Alternative Asset Digitalization and Loyalty Innovation, empowering organizations to unlock new value through tokenization, stablecoin infrastructure, and real-world asset integration.


Our globally distributed team of innovators, builders, and thinkers is passionate about the future of finance. Join Pointsville and be part of shaping the future of digital finance!


Overview

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Blockchain Engineering Manager to lead, mentor, and grow a distributed team of software engineers. This role is responsible for driving execution, ensuring technical excellence, and fostering a high-performance culture that delivers reliable, scalable, and high-quality products aligned with Pointsville’s strategic goals.


What You’ll Do

Product Strategy and Planning

  • Lead, coach, and mentor engineers across multiple technical domains.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement.
  • Support career growth, performance management, and professional development.
  • Participate in recruiting, onboarding, and building a diverse, high-performing team.


Execution and Delivery

  • Oversee the end-to-end software development lifecycle, from planning and design to deployment and maintenance.
  • Partner with the CTO and Product Manager to translate product roadmaps into engineering execution plans.
  • Manage delivery timelines, resources, and technical dependencies to ensure on-time releases.
  • Proactively identify and remove blockers, ensuring team productivity and alignment.


Performance and Improvement

  • Establish and enforce engineering best practices across code quality, smart contract security, and infrastructure reliability.
  • Ensure scalability, security, and performance in blockchain and microservice-based environments.
  • Drive the adoption of modern DevOps practices (IaC, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, automated testing).
  • Stay current with emerging blockchain technologies, protocols, and DeFi developments to guide innovation and continuous improvement.


Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of software development experience, including 6+ years in an engineering leadership or management role.
  • Familiarity with blockchains such as Ethereum and other blockchains preferred
  • Familiarity with DeFi trading a plus
  • Software engineering background in frontend and backend services development
  • An understanding of microservice architecture and cloud-based deployments
  • Experience in modern software development practices such as infrastructure as code, test automation, CI/CD and containerization
  • Proven success leading technical teams through the full product lifecycle in Agile or startup environments.
  • Experience with modern programming languages and frameworks (e.g., Java, Python, Node.js, Go, or C#).
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to balance technical depth with people management and cross-functional alignment.


We are committed to providing equal opportunity for qualified applicants to contract positions, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. This is a contract opportunity, not a direct employment role.

title: Blockchain Engineering Manager (Remote - LATAM)
description:
Blockchain Engineering Manager

Location: Americas, Remote


About Us

Pointsville is an end-to-end alternative asset factory, offering solutions that bridge the gap between emerging digital financial technologies and traditional asset classes. We specialize in Alternative Asset Digitalization and Loyalty Innovation, empowering organizations to unlock new value through tokenization, stablecoin infrastructure, and real-world asset integration.


Our globally distributed team of innovators, builders, and thinkers is passionate about the future of finance. Join Pointsville and be part of shaping the future of digital finance!


Overview

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Blockchain Engineering Manager to lead, mentor, and grow a distributed team of software engineers. This role is responsible for driving execution, ensuring technical excellence, and fostering a high-performance culture that delivers reliable, scalable, and high-quality products aligned with Pointsville’s strategic goals.


What You’ll Do

Product Strategy and Planning

  • Lead, coach, and mentor engineers across multiple technical domains.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement.
  • Support career growth, performance management, and professional development.
  • Participate in recruiting, onboarding, and building a diverse, high-performing team.


Execution and Delivery

  • Oversee the end-to-end software development lifecycle, from planning and design to deployment and maintenance.
  • Partner with the CTO and Product Manager to translate product roadmaps into engineering execution plans.
  • Manage delivery timelines, resources, and technical dependencies to ensure on-time releases.
  • Proactively identify and remove blockers, ensuring team productivity and alignment.


Performance and Improvement

  • Establish and enforce engineering best practices across code quality, smart contract security, and infrastructure reliability.
  • Ensure scalability, security, and performance in blockchain and microservice-based environments.
  • Drive the adoption of modern DevOps practices (IaC, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, automated testing).
  • Stay current with emerging blockchain technologies, protocols, and DeFi developments to guide innovation and continuous improvement.


Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of software development experience, including 6+ years in an engineering leadership or management role.
  • Familiarity with blockchains such as Ethereum and other blockchains preferred
  • Familiarity with DeFi trading a plus
  • Software engineering background in frontend and backend services development
  • An understanding of microservice architecture and cloud-based deployments
  • Experience in modern software development practices such as infrastructure as code, test automation, CI/CD and containerization
  • Proven success leading technical teams through the full product lifecycle in Agile or startup environments.
  • Experience with modern programming languages and frameworks (e.g., Java, Python, Node.js, Go, or C#).
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to balance technical depth with people management and cross-functional alignment.


We are committed to providing equal opportunity for qualified applicants to contract positions, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. This is a contract opportunity, not a direct employment role.

title: Gerente de projetos de TI
description:
Quem somos:

A Studio Rx é uma empresa de produção global digital, criada para as necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como Hub de produção da IPG Health, o Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo, tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência.


O que buscamos:

Como Gerente de Projetos, você trabalhará em colaboração com a equipe do Studio Rx e os times de Projetos e Client Services nos EUA. Diariamente, você deverá monitorar as atividades dos projetos em andamento, identificando e mitigando riscos, além de manter uma comunicação fluída entre todas as equipes envolvidas.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolvimento do plano do projeto: desde o entendimento e definição do escopo/briefing, passando pela estimativa de esforço e elaboração de cronogramas;
  • Alocação de equipe de acordo com habilidades necessárias, experiência e disponibilidade em parceria com o líder técnico da área de execução do projeto;
  • Gerenciamento e monitoramento das atividades diárias do projeto, garantindo o recebimento de todas as informações e materiais para execução das atividades, seguindo os protocolos de trabalho do Studio no Brasil e EUA;
  • Identificação, avaliação e mitigação de riscos, consolidando as informações em relatórios para a liderança sênior do projeto;
  • Garantir a comunicação entre os times de execução e demais envolvidos no projeto;
  • Esclarecimento de dúvidas quanto ao direcionamento da execução das atividades, interagindo com equipes responsáveis pelo projeto nos EUA;
  • Garantir a execução das atividades de acordo com prazos e tempo estimado, com a qualidade exigida, e seguindo os protocolos de trabalho do Studio no Brasil e EUA;
  • Elaboração de relatórios de andamento do projeto, e demais relatórios necessários para acompanhamento dos principais indicadores de sucesso das áreas de atuação.


Pré-Requisitos:

  • Inglês fluente (escrito e falado), pois trabalhará diretamente com times globais;
  • Graduação em áreas relacionadas à comunicação (Publicidade e Propaganda, Administração, Comunicação Social) ou TI (Processamento de dados, Análise de sistemas, Ciências da Computação);
  • Experiência consolidada com gestão de projetos.


Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência em agências de comunicação/publicidade;
  • Experiência no segmento healthcare (certificação Veeva é um plus);
  • Proficiência em metodologias de gerenciamento de projetos (Agile, Scrum etc.);
  • Proficiência em sistemas e/ou softwares de gerenciamento de projetos (MSFT Project, Workfront, Jira etc.)
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas usadas por desenvolvedores front-end e de campanhas digitais (Google Web Designer, Doubleclick Studio, GitHub, Adobe Creative Suite etc.).



Informações Adicionais:

Modelo de contratação: CLT

Modelo de trabalho: 100% Remoto

Horário de trabalho: Das 10h00 ás 19h00

title: Desenvolvedor Java AWS PL- SR
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições:​

Desenvolvimento de soluções robustas e escaláveis em ambientes bancários.

Manutenção e evolução de sistemas legados em Java, além de migração para arquiteturas modernas (microserviços).

Implementação de testes unitários e regressivos para garantir a qualidade do código.

Aplicação de práticas de observabilidade para monitoramento de sistemas.

Identificação e tratamento de vulnerabilidades de segurança.

Colaboração com equipes multidisciplinares para aprimorar continuamente os processos e produtos.


Requisitos e qualificações:​

Experiência sólida em Java (versões 8, 17, 21).

Conhecimento e experiência com AWS.

Ter noções de DevOps.

Foco em qualidade: testes unitários, testes regressivos, Sonar e tratamento de vulnerabilidades de segurança.

Conhecimento em observabilidade.

Experiência com DDD (Domain-Driven Design).

Conhecimento em Spring.

Capacidade crítica para identificar e implementar melhorias.

Familiaridade com JSP e monolitos em Java.

Experiência com microserviços, BFF (Backend for Frontend), Lambda, SQS e Kafka.


Diferenciais:​

Experiência prévia em projetos no setor bancário.

Capacidade de trabalho em ambientes remotos.

Valorizamos a diversidade em nossa equipe.

description:
Sobre a Oportunidade

A Eurofirms está apoiando uma grande empresa do setor logístico na busca por um(a) Gerente de Projetos de Transporte para atuar na gestão e implementação de projetos logísticos. O(a) profissional será o ponto focal (Focal Point) da implementação, garantindo que os projetos sejam entregues dentro do prazo, escopo e custo definidos, assegurando o alinhamento entre as áreas internas e o cliente.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar o ciclo de vida completo do projeto (abertura, planejamento, execução e encerramento);
  • Atuar como Focal Point na implementação de projetos internos e junto aos clientes;
  • Facilitar a comunicação e integração entre as áreas de BackOffice e o Cliente;
  • Controlar ações, cronogramas e custos do projeto;
  • Conduzir reuniões e preparar materiais para apresentação de status;
  • Definir e monitorar métricas de desempenho do projeto;
  • Reportar avanços, riscos e status do projeto;
  • Distribuir informações entre os departamentos envolvidos;
  • Direcionar recursos de forma eficiente;
  • Gerenciar e reportar riscos, propondo soluções para problemas durante a implementação;
  • Coletar e documentar Lessons Learned com o time ao final do projeto.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Engenharia ou Logística ;
  • Experiência comprovada em gestão de projetos e operações de Logística/Transportes;
  • Habilidades essenciais: foco no cliente, comunicação clara, visão de negócios, capacidade de execução e liderança;
  • Domínio avançado do Pacote Office (Excel e PowerPoint);
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.


Diferenciais (Desejáveis)

  • Proficiência em inglês;
  • MBA ou Pós-graduação em Gestão de Projetos.

title: Gerente de projetos de TI
description:
Quem somos:

A Studio Rx é uma empresa de produção global digital, criada para as necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como Hub de produção da IPG Health, o Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo, tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência.


O que buscamos:

Como Gerente de Projetos, você trabalhará em colaboração com a equipe do Studio Rx e os times de Projetos e Client Services nos EUA. Diariamente, você deverá monitorar as atividades dos projetos em andamento, identificando e mitigando riscos, além de manter uma comunicação fluída entre todas as equipes envolvidas.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolvimento do plano do projeto: desde o entendimento e definição do escopo/briefing, passando pela estimativa de esforço e elaboração de cronogramas;
  • Alocação de equipe de acordo com habilidades necessárias, experiência e disponibilidade em parceria com o líder técnico da área de execução do projeto;
  • Gerenciamento e monitoramento das atividades diárias do projeto, garantindo o recebimento de todas as informações e materiais para execução das atividades, seguindo os protocolos de trabalho do Studio no Brasil e EUA;
  • Identificação, avaliação e mitigação de riscos, consolidando as informações em relatórios para a liderança sênior do projeto;
  • Garantir a comunicação entre os times de execução e demais envolvidos no projeto;
  • Esclarecimento de dúvidas quanto ao direcionamento da execução das atividades, interagindo com equipes responsáveis pelo projeto nos EUA;
  • Garantir a execução das atividades de acordo com prazos e tempo estimado, com a qualidade exigida, e seguindo os protocolos de trabalho do Studio no Brasil e EUA;
  • Elaboração de relatórios de andamento do projeto, e demais relatórios necessários para acompanhamento dos principais indicadores de sucesso das áreas de atuação.


Pré-Requisitos:

  • Inglês fluente (escrito e falado), pois trabalhará diretamente com times globais;
  • Graduação em áreas relacionadas à comunicação (Publicidade e Propaganda, Administração, Comunicação Social) ou TI (Processamento de dados, Análise de sistemas, Ciências da Computação);
  • Experiência consolidada com gestão de projetos.


Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência em agências de comunicação/publicidade;
  • Experiência no segmento healthcare (certificação Veeva é um plus);
  • Proficiência em metodologias de gerenciamento de projetos (Agile, Scrum etc.);
  • Proficiência em sistemas e/ou softwares de gerenciamento de projetos (MSFT Project, Workfront, Jira etc.)
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas usadas por desenvolvedores front-end e de campanhas digitais (Google Web Designer, Doubleclick Studio, GitHub, Adobe Creative Suite etc.).



Informações Adicionais:

Modelo de contratação: CLT

Modelo de trabalho: 100% Remoto

Horário de trabalho: Das 10h00 ás 19h00

description:

Desenvolvimento de soluções robustas e escaláveis em ambientes bancários.

Manutenção e evolução de sistemas legados em Java, além de migração para arquiteturas modernas (microserviços).

Implementação de testes unitários e regressivos para garantir a qualidade do código.

Aplicação de práticas de observabilidade para monitoramento de sistemas.

Identificação e tratamento de vulnerabilidades de segurança.

Colaboração com equipes multidisciplinares para aprimorar continuamente os processos e produtos.

Experiência sólida em Java (versões 8, 17, 21).

Conhecimento e experiência com AWS.

Ter noções de DevOps.

Foco em qualidade: testes unitários, testes regressivos, Sonar e tratamento de vulnerabilidades de segurança.

Conhecimento em observabilidade.

Experiência com DDD (Domain-Driven Design).

Conhecimento em Spring.

Capacidade crítica para identificar e implementar melhorias.

Familiaridade com JSP e monolitos em Java.

Experiência com microserviços, BFF (Backend for Frontend), Lambda, SQS e Kafka.


Diferenciais:​

Experiência prévia em projetos no setor bancário.

Capacidade de trabalho em ambientes remotos.

Valorizamos a diversidade em nossa equipe.

title: Consultor(a) SAP ABAP
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


As pessoas são e continuarão sendo uma parte importante dessa missão. Em tudo o que fazemos, nossos funcionários desempenham um papel decisivo para nossos clientes e uns para os outros. O profissional será responsável por fazer análise dos processos desenvolvidos, encontrando falhas e propondo ajustes, desenvolver e manter soluções SAP avançadas, técnicas e garantindo a entrega de alta qualidade atendo diversos clientes de diversos setores.

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
About Turnkey

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software.

The TurnKey team is growing fast and worldwide! We have employees located in Eastern European countries and Latin America (Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, and Uruguay). We continue scaling remote software development teams for more than 30+ US-based enterprises and start-ups, including Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, Ironclad, BellXcel, etc. At TurnKey, we’re the ultimate matchmakers for US-based companies, creating remote dream teams.


Role Overview

We’re looking for a driven and detail-oriented Technical Recruiter to join our growing team. You will play a key role in sourcing and recruiting top tech and non-tech talent across Europe and Latin America , partnering closely with hiring managers and candidates to ensure an excellent recruitment experience from start to finish.


Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with internal teams and clients to understand hiring needs and role requirements
  • Source, screen, and engage candidates for a variety of technical and non-technical roles
  • Manage full-cycle recruitment: job posting, sourcing, screening, coordinating interviews, collecting feedback, and offer negotiation
  • Build and maintain talent pipelines for high-demand positions
  • Ensure a smooth and timely candidate experience, keeping stakeholders informed throughout the process
  • Collaborate with team members and hiring managers to continuously improve processes
  • Maintain accurate data in our applicant tracking systems and internal reports
  • Stay updated on regional hiring trends and market insights across Europe and LATAM


Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in recruiting for both technical and non-technical roles.
  • Strong knowledge of IT roles, technologies, and industry trends.
  • Familiarity with both technical and non-technical profiles
  • Solid sourcing skills and experience with LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, and other sourcing tools
  • Strong communication and organizational skills
  • Experience hiring in Latin America
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, remote-first environment
  • Upper-Intermediate + level of English
  • Readiness to work in various time zones according to the candidates’ time zone


Why You Should Work at TurnKey:

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team.
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks);
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget.
  • Private health insurance.
  • Free advanced English lessons with a budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work;
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes.
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together.
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise.

We’re looking for a driven and detail-oriented Technical Recruiter to join our growing team. title: Desenvolvedor Java AWS PL- SR
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições:​

Desenvolvimento de soluções robustas e escaláveis em ambientes bancários.

Manutenção e evolução de sistemas legados em Java, além de migração para arquiteturas modernas (microserviços).

Implementação de testes unitários e regressivos para garantir a qualidade do código.

Aplicação de práticas de observabilidade para monitoramento de sistemas.

Identificação e tratamento de vulnerabilidades de segurança.

Colaboração com equipes multidisciplinares para aprimorar continuamente os processos e produtos.


Requisitos e qualificações:​

Experiência sólida em Java (versões 8, 17, 21).

Conhecimento e experiência com AWS.

Ter noções de DevOps.

Foco em qualidade: testes unitários, testes regressivos, Sonar e tratamento de vulnerabilidades de segurança.

Conhecimento em observabilidade.

Experiência com DDD (Domain-Driven Design).

Conhecimento em Spring.

Capacidade crítica para identificar e implementar melhorias.

Familiaridade com JSP e monolitos em Java.

Experiência com microserviços, BFF (Backend for Frontend), Lambda, SQS e Kafka.


Diferenciais:​

Experiência prévia em projetos no setor bancário.

Capacidade de trabalho em ambientes remotos.

Valorizamos a diversidade em nossa equipe.

title: Consultor(a) SAP ABAP
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


As pessoas são e continuarão sendo uma parte importante dessa missão. Em tudo o que fazemos, nossos funcionários desempenham um papel decisivo para nossos clientes e uns para os outros. É por isso que estamos sempre em busca de profissionais experientes e em início de carreira para se juntarem à nossa equipe.


Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.


Estamos em busca de um Consultor Desenvolvedor ABAP com experiência em Desenvolvimento e Depuração para integrar nossa equipe de AMS.


Responsabilidade:


O profissional será responsável por fazer análise dos processos desenvolvidos, encontrando falhas e propondo ajustes, desenvolver e manter soluções SAP avançadas, técnicas e garantindo a entrega de alta qualidade atendo diversos clientes de diversos setores.


Formato de Trabalho: Remoto

Contratação: CLT



Requisitos :

  • Conhecimento avançado em Depuração objetos Standards e Desenvolvidos
  • Desenvolver e manter programas complexos em ABAP para atender às necessidades dos clientes.
  • Realizar análise de requisitos e documentação técnica detalhada.
  • Colaborar com equipes funcionais e outros desenvolvedores para transformar requisitos de negócios em soluções técnicas.
  • Garantir a conformidade com as melhores práticas de desenvolvimento SAP e padrões de qualidade.
  • Fornecer suporte técnico avançado e resolução de problemas relacionados às soluções desenvolvidas.
  • Atuar como mentor e líder técnico para desenvolvedores de nível júnior e pleno.
  • Participar ativamente em projetos de implementação e atualização de sistemas SAP.



Formação e experiência desejada:

  • Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento ABAP.
  • Conhecimento em formulários (AdobeForm, Smarforms e SapScript )
  • Conhecimento e experiência em SAP Fiori, incluindo SAPUI5 e OData.
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento e manutenção de workflows SAP.
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de relatórios, interfaces, conversões, melhoramentos e formulários
  • Capacidade de entender e traduzir especificações funcionais complexas em soluções técnicas eficazes.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente e liderar equipes técnicas.



Diferenciais:

  • Certificações SAP relevantes.
  • Experiência em projetos de implementação SAP S/4HANA.
  • Conhecimentos em outras tecnologias SAP como SAP Gateway, AMDPs, BTP, Webdympro.
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Participação em projetos internacionais ou ambientes multiculturais.

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
About Turnkey

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software.

The TurnKey team is growing fast and worldwide! We have employees located in Eastern European countries and Latin America (Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, and Uruguay). We continue scaling remote software development teams for more than 30+ US-based enterprises and start-ups, including Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, Ironclad, BellXcel, etc. At TurnKey, we’re the ultimate matchmakers for US-based companies, creating remote dream teams.


Role Overview

We’re looking for a driven and detail-oriented Technical Recruiter to join our growing team. You will play a key role in sourcing and recruiting top tech and non-tech talent across Europe and Latin America , partnering closely with hiring managers and candidates to ensure an excellent recruitment experience from start to finish.


Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with internal teams and clients to understand hiring needs and role requirements
  • Source, screen, and engage candidates for a variety of technical and non-technical roles
  • Manage full-cycle recruitment: job posting, sourcing, screening, coordinating interviews, collecting feedback, and offer negotiation
  • Build and maintain talent pipelines for high-demand positions
  • Ensure a smooth and timely candidate experience, keeping stakeholders informed throughout the process
  • Collaborate with team members and hiring managers to continuously improve processes
  • Maintain accurate data in our applicant tracking systems and internal reports
  • Stay updated on regional hiring trends and market insights across Europe and LATAM


Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in recruiting for both technical and non-technical roles.
  • Strong knowledge of IT roles, technologies, and industry trends.
  • Familiarity with both technical and non-technical profiles
  • Solid sourcing skills and experience with LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, and other sourcing tools
  • Strong communication and organizational skills
  • Experience hiring in Latin America
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, remote-first environment
  • Upper-Intermediate + level of English
  • Readiness to work in various time zones according to the candidates’ time zone


Why You Should Work at TurnKey:

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team.
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks);
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget.
  • Private health insurance.
  • Free advanced English lessons with a budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work;
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes.
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together.
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise.

title: Desenvolvedor Java AWS PL- SR
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições:​

Desenvolvimento de soluções robustas e escaláveis em ambientes bancários.

Manutenção e evolução de sistemas legados em Java, além de migração para arquiteturas modernas (microserviços).

Implementação de testes unitários e regressivos para garantir a qualidade do código.

Aplicação de práticas de observabilidade para monitoramento de sistemas.

Identificação e tratamento de vulnerabilidades de segurança.

Colaboração com equipes multidisciplinares para aprimorar continuamente os processos e produtos.


Requisitos e qualificações:​

Experiência sólida em Java (versões 8, 17, 21).

Conhecimento e experiência com AWS.

Ter noções de DevOps.

Foco em qualidade: testes unitários, testes regressivos, Sonar e tratamento de vulnerabilidades de segurança.

Conhecimento em observabilidade.

Experiência com DDD (Domain-Driven Design).

Conhecimento em Spring.

Capacidade crítica para identificar e implementar melhorias.

Familiaridade com JSP e monolitos em Java.

Experiência com microserviços, BFF (Backend for Frontend), Lambda, SQS e Kafka.


Diferenciais:​

Experiência prévia em projetos no setor bancário.

Capacidade de trabalho em ambientes remotos.

Valorizamos a diversidade em nossa equipe.

title: Consultor(a) SAP ABAP

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
About Turnkey

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software.

The TurnKey team is growing fast and worldwide! We have employees located in Eastern European countries and Latin America (Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, and Uruguay). We continue scaling remote software development teams for more than 30+ US-based enterprises and start-ups, including Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, Ironclad, BellXcel, etc. At TurnKey, we’re the ultimate matchmakers for US-based companies, creating remote dream teams.


Role Overview

We’re looking for a driven and detail-oriented Technical Recruiter to join our growing team. You will play a key role in sourcing and recruiting top tech and non-tech talent across Europe and Latin America , partnering closely with hiring managers and candidates to ensure an excellent recruitment experience from start to finish.


Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with internal teams and clients to understand hiring needs and role requirements
  • Source, screen, and engage candidates for a variety of technical and non-technical roles
  • Manage full-cycle recruitment: job posting, sourcing, screening, coordinating interviews, collecting feedback, and offer negotiation
  • Build and maintain talent pipelines for high-demand positions
  • Ensure a smooth and timely candidate experience, keeping stakeholders informed throughout the process
  • Collaborate with team members and hiring managers to continuously improve processes
  • Maintain accurate data in our applicant tracking systems and internal reports
  • Stay updated on regional hiring trends and market insights across Europe and LATAM


Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in recruiting for both technical and non-technical roles.
  • Strong knowledge of IT roles, technologies, and industry trends.
  • Familiarity with both technical and non-technical profiles
  • Solid sourcing skills and experience with LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, and other sourcing tools
  • Strong communication and organizational skills
  • Experience hiring in Latin America
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, remote-first environment
  • Upper-Intermediate + level of English
  • Readiness to work in various time zones according to the candidates’ time zone


Why You Should Work at TurnKey:

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team.
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks);
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget.
  • Private health insurance.
  • Free advanced English lessons with a budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work;
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes.
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together.
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise.

description:

We’re looking for a driven and detail-oriented Technical Recruiter to join our growing team. Key Responsibilities

  • Source, screen, and engage candidates for a variety of technical and non-technical roles
  • Manage full-cycle recruitment: job posting, sourcing, screening, coordinating interviews, collecting feedback, and offer negotiation
  • Build and maintain talent pipelines for high-demand positions
  • Ensure a smooth and timely candidate experience, keeping stakeholders informed throughout the process
  • Collaborate with team members and hiring managers to continuously improve processes
  • Maintain accurate data in our applicant tracking systems and internal reports
  • Stay updated on regional hiring trends and market insights across Europe and LATAM

  • 3+ years of experience in recruiting for both technical and non-technical roles.

  • Strong communication and organizational skills
  • Experience hiring in Latin America

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Who We Are?

Softensity is a US-based IT outsourcing company with global software teams. We are headquartered in Atlanta, GA, USA with development teams in LATAM, Eastern Europe and Türkiye. When you have better teams, you build better software. Let’s do this together!


We are currently seeking a dynamic and inquisitive Senior Software Engineer with strong technical skills and the ability to navigate organizational dynamics, with of adaptability and foundational knowledge in security applications


The Project:

Our client’s platform runs on the Microsoft Azure cloud and follows a microservices architecture. They run a mix of open source, vendor-licensed, and internally developed tools to perform functions such as provisioning, software deployment, logging, and monitoring.

You'll learn these tools and have opportunities to improve them. The team is collaborative; they work closely with the development teams and support to deliver the best results for the organization. The goal is to balance the best solution with the need to get things done for each engineering challenge we face.


Technical Skills:

Must have

  • Proficiency in .NET Core
  • Proficiency in Cloud (ideally Azure , but AWS or GCP are acceptable)
  • Strong background in Microservices architecture
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Bicep , ARM templates , Terraform , or Pulumi
  • Experience with Event Hubs , Service Bus , or similar
  • Knowledge of Container Apps , Function Apps , App Services
  • Experience with Storage Accounts , CDN , Subscriptions , Resource Groups
  • Understanding of App Insights , Log Analytics
  • Experience managing RBAC , Managed Identities , SPNs , App Registrations
  • Hands-on experience with Docker
  • Database skills with Azure SQL, MongoDB, SQL, and Cosmos DB

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with GitHub Actions or similar CI/CD tools
  • Familiarity with cloud automation , especially infrastructure automation
  • Comfortable exploring Infrastructure as Code (IaC) , Developer Experience (DX) , UI , and architecture as necessary
  • Familiarity with widely used Azure resources , including ASB/Event Hub , AKS/ACA , Storage Account


Why Join Us?

We are passionate about top quality talent and giving our team members the tools they need for them to keep on growing and learning. The sky is truly the limit and we want you to feel challenged and motivated in every single project that you're a part of all while working with cutting edge technologies and amazing clients.


What to expect?

  • Coursera credentials
  • Remote work
  • Learning opportunities


Softensity is an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants are considered without regard to gender, identity, or personal background.
